mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% coincident with falling housing starts (HOUST) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < -2% AND HOUST falls for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profit margins, which in turn drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both personal savings (RSAFS) and unemployment (UNRATE) above their previous 12-month averages signals a precautionary saving behavior in response to labor market uncertainty, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > previous 12-month avg AND UNRATE > previous 12-month avg for 2 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate held below 1% for more than six months in an extended period of low inflation (CPIAUCSL growth < 1% YoY) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that supports risk asset valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% for >6 months AND CPIAUCSL YoY < 1%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) above 250k per month for three consecutive months signals a robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A strong, sustained monthly increase in the Housing Starts index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average, combined with rising personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1), signals improving housing demand and broader consumption recovery, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 12-month avg for 2 consecutive months AND GDPC1 > 12-month avg
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.
